text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fotón nisqankunaqa aswan uchuykunallas imaña átomo nisqankuta rikurichimuqninkunamantaqa!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Yaqapas pachak horaskuna ruwaynin tukuyta, k'anchaq q'aytun tukuyninpiqa ruphapusqa, k'anchaqtaq mana funcionapunñachu.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Qatiriqman, chaninmi bombilla nisqa tikray. Hinaqa allillamantan rantinta churaspa kana.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Qallariyqa, k'anchaq interruptor nisqata wañuchinayki utaq cableta urqunayki.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Kaysi, kanchiy rikurichimuq kuyuriptin qatan lawman maypi bombilla nisqankupa metálica nisqanku kasqan raykus ima kallpayuq llipyatapas rikurichimunman qatanpa ukunta tuparuptinkuqa utaq metal kaqninta chayllaraq wakin qatapiraq kaptinqa.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Ancha chaninchasqa kaqnin sistema circulatoriopaqa sunqus, yawarta pawarichiq.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Yawarqa sunqumanta lluqsin yarqakunamanta sirka nisqa sutichasqa chaymantataq kutin sunquman huk yarqakuna ukunta sirka sutiyuq.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Triceratopspa kirunkunaqa manan rapikunallatachu ñitinman, hinallataq kallmankunatapas sapinkunatapas aswan chila kaqta.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Wakin cientifico nisqakuna Triceratops mikuq cícadas nisqa kasqaku, huk huñu sachan Cretasico pachapi wiñasqa.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Kay yurakunaqa yaqapas huchuy chunta sachahina huk ñawchi laphi kuchukuq winchayuq.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Huk Triceratopspa kapka tupsan rurasqa karqa tipiypaq rapikuna ñawpaqmanta kurku mikuspa.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Uk chanin hamutaqkunan willakunku kay qurakunaqa wañuchiy kamaqmi nispa, chayraykun dinosaurio nisqa mana mikurqanchu, ichaqa kallakuna qilla ukukuna ima mikunkun chay wañuchikuq qurakunap rapinta.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Imaynatan waqamuwanman lo nisqa llasaturakuta? Lo nisqa panpanpi kachkayman chayqa, tiqsi muyuq llasa kaynin aswan chusaq pisitaraq llasayman.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Huk runa 200 libras (90 kg) nisqata llasanman chanta pampa Pachapi llasanman 36 libras (16 kg) nisqata Io nisqapi. Chanta gravedad nisqa chiqaypaymi pisita chutamusunki.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Intiqa manan tiqsi pacha inachu pampayuq, aswanpas rupa puyullan nina inaraq yawraq.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Waksiqa ñañuyapunmi sapa inti chawpinmanta ayqikuspa.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Fotosferan sutin Intiq hawan qawasqanchik, “nina sinku” nispan sutiyakun.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Yaqapas kimsa waranqa qipaman, 1610 watapi, astronomo Italiano Galileo Galilei hatun qawanawan qawarqan kay Venus mita taqankunami, imayna killa hina.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Tikrakuykunami rurakun tiqsi muyu Venus huk uyan kanchakuptin (utaq Killaqpa) Inti hawariqman. Venus tikrayninkuna Copérnico yachayta qimin, llapan tiqsi muyukuna Intita muyupanku.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Chaymanta, qipa watakunamanqa, 1639 watapi, huk astrónomo inglés Jeremiah Horrocks sutiyuq, rikusqa huk tránsito Venus nisqamanta.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Inglaterra taq kawsayta tarisqa unay wataña, danelaw llaqtata llallispa.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ichaqa 991 watapi Ethelred Vikingo taqaman ankallikurqan aswan hatunmanraq Guthrum nisqamantapa huk siglo ñawpaqtaraq.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Kay illanakunapaq huñuysi Olaf Trygvasson nisqanku umanchasqa, Noruegamanta runa achka munaykunawan suyunta sapanyachinanpaq Danéskunamanta.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Chanta wallakuna mana chaninpi kasqankurayku qallariyninpi, Ethelred allinpi Olafwan rimanakun, paymi Noruegaman kutimuran atipaspa reinon nisqaman aypanan.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul nisqa rimay qillqaqa qunqaylla kamarisqan imaynatachus runa rimarqan chayman ina. Chay qillqaqa 1444 watapin rikurirqan Sejong rey kamachiq kachkaptin(1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Rey Sejong tawañiqin rey Joseon Dinastiamanta karqan chanta aswan allin qawasqa.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, qallariyninpi sutiyarqan, “ima kunkatapas runa yachachinapaq” chaninmi nispa.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Kanmi imaymanam teoría nisqakuna, imaynata rikhurimunman karqan sáncristo nisqa. Huk kaqninqa ninmi kunti suyupa aria ripuymanta Indiaman chaymi rimasqan simintapas apamunpa paykunawan.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanscristo simiqa ñawpa simin yaqapas Latin niraqmi Europapi rimakusqanhina.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: ñawpaq patara tiqsimuyupi riqsisqa. Upanishads sutichasqakunaq pallapaynin qiqataqa, sanscrito nisqa pisiyarparin kikillanmanta.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sancristo simim sasa rimana simi ichataq allin miski simi, kay simita llapan Musuq Indio simikunapaqmi sapinchakuyta qusqa karqan, Latinhina, Europeo simikunahina Frances, Español simikunapa sapin kasqa.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Francia maqanakuywan tukusqa kaqtin, Alemania qallarin Gran Bretañaq wata pachan hapikunanpaq.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemania sutichasqa atipayta “Operación Sealion” nisqanwan. Achka llasaq armankunas chaynallataq llapa iman Britanicokunapa chinkarqusqa Dunkerqueman apasqankupi, chayrayku atipakuqkuna ancha irqi kasqa.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ichaqa Royal Navy astawan kallpachasqa karqan kay Alemania Navy nisqamanta (“Kriegsmarine”) hinaqa mayqin wanputapas hapikuqkunaqta kanan Canal Ingles nisqa ñanninta.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Ichaqa, pisi Royal Navy wanpukunaqa yanqa hapikuq ñankunata puririnanku karqan almirantekunañataq manchakuranku ichapas hanaqmanta avionkunawan Alemankuna wanputaqa uramachinkunamanta.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Qallarisun Italia suyup munayninkunamanta rimaspa. Italia suyuqa karqan “uchuy wayqi” Alemania suyuq inallataq Japon suyuq.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Wallankunaqa pisillan llalliy atiyllan, chayraqmi tawa wanpukunata rurasqaku, awqanakuy chayraq qallarichkaptin.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italiapa munayninsi kasqa Africa suyukuna. Kaykunata hapikurunanpaqsi, imayna tropakuna lluqsinanpaq yachananku puni kasqa, chaynapi tropakuna wampunanpaq Mediteráneo quchamamantinta Africaman yaykunankupaq.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Chaypaqqa, wanpukunata, bases británicas nisqakunapiwan Egipto nisqapi chaykunamantas pachkachipusqaku. Aswantaq chay ruwaykunapiqa, nikunan karan acorazados Italia nisqakunamanta mana imatapas ruwankumanchukaran.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Kunantaq Japonpaq. Japonqa huk wayta ayllu karqa, Gran Bretañahina.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Qucha ukunta waytaq wanpukuna yaku ukunta purinapaq chaymantapa chay ukupi kanman hinantin pacha pasayta.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Submarinu nisqanchikmi I ñawpaq chaynataq II iskay kaqpi Tiqsi Muyu awqanakuyninpim. Chay pachakunapiqa submarinunaqa kuyurqa allimanta pisillata qichpalltan tuqllachirqa.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Hatun awqanakuy qallariptinmi yaku hanayninpi submarinukuna purirqa, ichaqa chay radarkuna qispiruptin submarinukuna yaykurqun mama qucha ukuman purinanpaq.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Unuq ukunta suchuq alemania wanpukunaqa, U-Boats nispan sutichakurqan, Aleman runakunaqa chanintan wanpukunapi yakup ukunta suchurqanku.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Submarinokunawan llallisqanmanrayku, maqanakuy tukuyta, manan iñikusqankumanchu Alemaneskunaqa chaypin kachichkankuman.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: ¡Arí! Rey Tutankamón, wakinpi “Rey Tut” niqku utaq “Warma rey”, pim kasqa hukkaqnin rey ñawpaq Egipto suyumanta kunan pachakunapi ancha riqsisqa.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Asina hinan, ñawpa pachapi manan chaninchakuqchu, inaqa manan rapipi qillqasqachu karqan ñawpa riykuna.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Chay nisqan, 1922 watapi aya panpan tarikusqanmanta raymichayqa kapun. Ichaqa achka aya panpakuna suwasqachikusqa kasqa, aswancha kay aya panpaqa sumaq chaninlla kasqa.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Wichayman nikunmi, ñawchinpin qallarinayki inaqa tanqarinaykitaqmi arco nisqaman, uraymantaq nikun, qallarinayki nuez nisqapi (may makiykiq hapisqan arcopi) inaqa arcota chutanayki.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Muyukuna radios nisqakunata rikurichiy carrukuna chusaqchachiyta rurasqa, utqayman puriq chaymantapas allin rurasqata awqaqkunata huk carrukunata ima llallinapaq.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Auqnkunapa chukinqa ima pachankutapas haykurunmanchá wañuchinankama. Yaqapas 1000 watapi a.c., asiriokuna ñawpaq caballeria nisqata riqsichiranku.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Huk kawalleriaqa awqaq suyun, kawallu patapi takanakuq. Karunantaqa manaraqmi inventakusqaraqchu, chay nisqaqa Asiria kawalliriaqa qala wasa kawallullapis takanakusqaku karqan.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Achka Griego politicokunata, cientificokunata, artistakunata ima yachayku. Icha Homerom aswan riqsisqasqa runa kay kawsay sapimanta, ñawpa ñawsa arawiq, literatura griegapa iskay allin chanin obrakunata ruwan: La Iliada, La Odisea arawiqpiwan.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocles hinallataq Aristofanes chanin yarawiqkunan kanku llaqtaq munanan, rurayninkutaqmi tiqsimuyuntinpi riqsisqa.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Huk Griego allin riqsisqa, Pitagoras yupay kamayniyuq, aswan riqsisqa kimsa kuchukunaq siqin tinkunakusqanwan hinallataq tawa kuchu chutarisqapuwanpas.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Aska yuyakunan awakun hayka runakunan hindú rimayta atinku. Ninkutaq iskay ñiqipi utaq tawa ñiqipin kanman tiqsimuyuntin rimayninpi.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Ayllupi rimaqkunaqa kuyunkun huchuy kaq simikunata yupakusqanmanrayku.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Chawpichasqa rangumi 340 hunupi hinallataq 500 hunu rimaqkunaman qawarikun, achka 800 hunu runakuna hina simita uyarinkuman.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hidiwan Urdus kaqlla rimana simikunapi ichaqa manas kaqllachu qillqayninkupiqa; sapa punchaw rimanakuykunapis, kay iskay runasimikunata rimaqkunas anchata mana sasachakunkuchu rimanakuspanku.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Kay Siglo 15 pachapim Estonia chinchan suyunmi Alemania suyupa kawsayninta qatikurqa.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Wakin Aleman umukuna kamaq yayaman achuyachiyta munasqaku llaqtayuqkunata, chayraykun huk rimayta paqarichirqanku estonio nisqata.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Aleman sanampakunallunpapi yasapakusqa, huk sanampa “Õ/õ” kaqta yapakusqa.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Unay pacha puririsqanman hinas, achka simikunas alemánmanta qapisqanku hukllawakurusqa. Kaysi kanchariypa qallariynin kasqa.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Riqsisqaman hinañas, pi tiyana saqinanman tiyananpaqsi rinanpuni atipakuq aylluman (ejército) yachaywasita tukuspa.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: ichaqa, Charles riram hatun suntur yachay wasiman Trinity Collegepi, Cambridge, chaypi yachayninta huntara Antropologia Arqueollogiatapas, hinamantaq Ñupa kausaykamayuqta, 2:2 atipaspa (ikay ñeqe chaninchayta pisipi reqsisqata).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Carlosqa Real Británica Ayllumanta ñawpaq chaskiq runa huk licenciaturawan kasqa.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turquía europea nisqankus (Traciaq inti lluqsiman lawpi utaq Rumelia península Balcanes nisqankupi), kaymi 3% suyupa kaqnin.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turquia suyu 1, 600 kilometros allpan (1000 millas) chutarikuyninpi inallataq 800 km (500 millas) palta kayninpi, tawa kuchu chutarikuyninman ina.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Tuquíapa panpanqa, quchakunayuqta ima, 783, 562 kilómetros cuadrados (300, 948 millas cuadradas) nisqayuqmi, chaykunamantaqa 755, 688 kilómetros cuadrados (291, 773 millas cuadradas) nisqa, Asiaq anti suyunpi tarikun chaymantapa 23, 764 kilómetros cuadrados (9, 174 millas cuadradas) nisqa Europapi.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turquia allpan 37 suyuntinpi aswan hatunta qawarichispa kay teqsimuyuntinpi hinaqa yaqapas Francia llaqta hina sayayninpi hinallataq reino unido nisqawanpas.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turquiaqa mama qachawan muyurisqa kimsa kuchunpi: Egeo qucha quntiman, yana qucha chinchayninman hinataq Mediteraneo quchawan qullanpi.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxenburgo llaqtaqa chanin willakuyniyuqmi, ichaqa 1839 watapin qispiynin qillqasqa kachkan.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Kunan Bélgicapa llaqtankuna kaqmi ñawpaqpi Luxemburgopa llaqtankuna karqa, ichaqa Belgicamantañam revolución Belga qipamanqa 1830 watapi.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburgo suyuqa hinantin kayninpiqa mana imamanpas haykuyta munaqchu karqan, ichaqa iskaynin I Pacha Maqanakuy, Pacha Maqanakuypipas Alemania suyuqa chaypin kayusqa karqan.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: 1957 watapi. Luxemburgo wakirusqa huk kaynin tiqsichiypi huñunakuymanta, kunantaq riqsikun Unión Europea nisqa.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong pukara tuñisqa monasterio budistapiwan Paro (Phondey Village nisqapi) llaqtaq wichayninpi.
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: 1649 watapi, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel hatun pirqakunata rikurichisqa tibetano-mongolkuna llallirqusqanta yuyapayananpaq.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: 1951 watapi nina kanaywan lliwta chusaqyachipun qiparin Drukgya Dzong inallataq Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal chayllaña.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Chanta ninamantam, pukara waqaychakusqa harkakusqantinmi, yuyarinapaq Butánmanta hatun sumaq munaykaspa.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Siglo18 nisqankupis, Cambodias sasachakuypi kasqa kay iskay hatun suykunapa chawpinpi kaspa, Tailandiapa chaynallataq Vietnampa.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Taislandia suyumanta llaqtamasikunayuq Cambodia nisqaman achka kutikuna siglo 18 nisqapi hinallataq 1772 nisqapipas llumpisqan chantapas Phnom Phen nisqata chinkachipurqanku.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: 18 siglo qipa watakunaman, Vietnamitakuna yanqata hapikunku Camboyatapas.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Yaqapas chunqa pusaqniyuq pachak pachakmi Venezolanokuna mana llankayniyuq tarikunku, llapan llankayniyuqkunataq economía informalpi llankachkanku.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Iskay kimsa wakin lliwmanta llamkaq venezolanokunas yanapakuy ayllupi llamkanku, yaqa tawa wakin lliwmantañataq llamkanku industriapi, pichqa wakin lliwmantañataq chakrapi.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Huk hatun chanin llankay Venezolanokunapaq allpa wira, kay suyuqa hatun rakiqmi, chaypa huk pachaqnin pachaqllas kay allpa wirapiqa llankan.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Manas mana kaqpaq yachapakuy atiychu, mana allinninpi hina yachapakuy nisqankullas; kaysi “sasachachin yaqa 3 - 5% lliw taksa warmakunata, ichapas yaqa 2 waranqa Estados Unidospi kaq warmakunata”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Kay warmakunaqa yaqapas imaymana sasachakuykunaman winakunku, “ichaqa mana allin ruwaykunaman haykuspa maqanakunku umalliqkunatapas allquchachispa” ñuqtunta estimulanankupaq, ichaqa manan métodos normaleskunawanqqa estimulakunchu.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Kaytaqa allintan yuyayniykipi chaninchanayki imaymana mana munasqaykitapas utaq ama ruwanaykipaq.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Chusachiq wasikuna siglo 19 pachamanta kachkanku. Chusachiq wasi aswan allin chayllaraq chusaqkunapaq chayta chusay yachaqkunapaq pachaman hina, kawsayman, rimayman utaq pisi chaninniyuq suyukunaman hatunyachin.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Yaqapas llapan agenciakunan kicharisqan kachkanku chaskinankupaqqa llapan kaqlla waqaychanakunata, achka agenciakunan imaymana partikular chusaqkunapi, rangu qullqikunayuq utaq chayanapiwan akllakunku.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Allinmi imayna munasqayki ruwawaq pasaje waqaychaqman anchuykuy.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Huk qawariyta quriy puriq agente promosionachkan chayta, ichapas web kitimanta utaq qawanamantapas.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Maynillanpi, allin qawarisqa allpakunaman haykunku, montañismo nisqaman huntakunanpaq polo nisqaman chayanapaqpas, chaypi hatun wasi kan.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (o autopista) (utaq autopista nisqa) 1600 km chaski ñan nisqa kasqa McMurdo sayananpi Mar de Ross nisqamanta Polokama.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Chila riti huntachasqa tukukunawan chaymantapas wipalakunawan yupichasqa. Allin yachaq tractores nisqakunallawanmi purinman, trineos combustible nisqawan, suministros nisqakunawanpas apaspa.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Kaykunaqa manam chitichu kanku, Chusay ñanqa kanan Urqukunam muyuriynintinpi antartica chawpinpi pampaman chayananpaq.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Carreterakunapi llaki sasachaykuna api lluskariq carretera kaptinmi rurakun, kallkikuna patapatankunapa.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Pisipi hina, allin kawkachutan munanan. Kawkachukuna quñi pachapaq aswan lluskaqmi kanku chullunkupi hinallataq ritipipas, hinallataq wakin chiraw pachapaq kawkachukunapas sasachayniyuqmi.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Kamachiq ruranaqa kanan allin ukukama, 5mm (1/5 pulgadakunamanta) utaq astawan, llamkanataq chanin llapiyachalla chiri pachakunapaq.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Wakin botas nisqakuna tachuelayuq kasqa chaymantapa kanmi huk yapa huñusqa tachuelas nisqawan lluskaq pampakunapaq, allin churasqa llapan zapayokunapa botaskunapaq ima, tacones nisqakunapaqpa utaq tacones suela ima.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Taykukunaqa huchuy ñañullapiwan kanan. Hinantinpi aqu, challa utaq kachi ima wichñirikunanpaq (cloruro de calcio) nisqa carru ñankunapi utaq chaki ñankunapipas mastaynin allinchananpaq.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Lluqllakunaqa manan yanqa yanqachu kanku, sayasqa qhatakunaqa huk chikan ritillatan harkanku, sinchita huntarun chayqa achka lluqlla pasayamunqa.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Sasachayqa ritiqa kaskakuqmi, ichapas rikcharinman urmayapunanpaq, hinaqa chikan riti urmaqqa kanmanmi imapas kananpaq hukkunapaqpas.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Huk kutikunapiqa, chay evento desecadenate original chayqa kasqa inti rit'i q'uñichiq, wakinkunapitaq rit'ita, hukkutikunapitaq imaymana eventos naturales nisqakunata, huk runatahina.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Tornado nisqankus hatun muyuq wiñariq wayra llumpay pisi presión nisqankupi, wayra muyuqta suquspan uku lawmanraq hanayniqmanraq.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: hatun wayrakunatan wiñarqunku (pasaqlla 100-200millas nisqata/ pachapi) hinaqa qoqarinkumanmi llasaq imakunatapas, aparikunkumanmi suchusqanman hina.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Hanaq pacha puyumanta uraykamun muyuq “wayra hina” chaymanta muyuq wayraman tukun panpaman tupaspa.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: RPV quqkuna runaq (sapaq llika virtual) chaykunan kanku aswan ayqiy, kawsay pinqay hinataq taqay rantiypipas IP- geo.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Proxis webpaq kuraqninkunan imaymanarayku: paykunaqa huk ñanman llapan trafico internetta apachinku, manan http nisqallachu.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Yachasqanchikhina qunku hatun mastariy banda nisqata hukkunataq allin chanin yanapakuyta. Pakasqa kasqanku, chayraykutaq, sasa rikusqanalla kanku.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Willay kamayuq wasikuna llullakunku pasaqlla kay imapas chaninchaymanta, chay “prevenir pirateria nisqata” suwakuy.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: hinapuni, suyu seqekuna manapunin allinpi qawasqachu mana chanin copia nisqakunapi; copia bit hoq bitman huk disco nisqapi hinaqa mayqenpipas atikullanqan may chaninpi kaq ruwasqa hina.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Chainpimi kachkan qatuq wasikunata may qatunankupipas qawarinapaqmi; qullqi purichiytan chaninchana.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Qayanakuy internetnintakama kasqanrayku, manaña kamachikunaykichu compañía telefónica nisqanku kananta may yachasqaykipi utaq may illanaykiman.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Manam kananpunichu huk tiyana aylluq yupaymi llaqta tiyasqankupi; huk hapipanata urqusqa Internet nisqaman satélite nisqa ukunta chicken purun ayllukunapi, Alaskapi, chaymantapas akllakunan huk yupayta chay quñisqa Arizonapi tarikusqanta.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Chayna kaptin, rantinanmi huk lluynintin taqasqa yupayta haykuchinantaqmi llapan teléfonos PSTN nisqakuna allinta waqamunanta. Maymantachus hamuy chay yupay, chaymi takayninta nin waqasqanku runakunapaq.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Simi tikrachiq llamkanakuna nisqankunas chaylla tikraykachin hatun qillqaykunata huk simimanta huk kaqman.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Wakin llamkanakuna kay ñiqichanapi qillqakunata tikrankumanmi huk simikunamanta willakuq qillqasqakunapi ima hukkunapipas chanin kawsaykunapi telefono nisqata chay ima kasqanmanpas qawarichiqtiyki.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Simi tikrachiqkunam sumaq sumaqta allinyarunku, chaymi ancha allin kaqman tikrachichkanku (kantaqmi tumpa sasa riqsina qillqaykuna), ichaqa suma-sumaqtam qawana, yaqapas pantarunanmanta.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Huk kaqnin kay llamkanakunaq chanin kancharisqa kay ñiqichanapi kasqa Google Translate nisqa, munasqayki rimay tikrayta manam tinkisqa nisqallawan uraykachispa tukuyta simikunaq yachanapaq qillqakuna munasqata.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: GPS nisqawan puriy yachaq Telefonoykipi aswan allinmi kanman manam suyuykipi kaspayki.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Qullqita waqaychawarmi musuq mapa nisqakunata rantispa huk GPS nisqapaq, utaq huk sapan dispositivo GPS nisqata utaq mañakuwaqpas huk hatun llamkana alkilaypaq coches nisqapi.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Manataq kanchu huk tinkisqa willayta telefonoykipaq, utaq manam aypanan hawanpi kashanki chayqa, tukukullaq atiyninwa kanqa utaq manam imapa kanqachu.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Sapankan qhatu wasikuna llaqtachakunapi huntasqan kachkan imaymana sasachakusqa achka ñawpa payllasqa tarhitakuna telefonomanta, llapan runapaq telefonomanta churanapaq.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Allin kaptin, aswan kuraqninpi taygeta nisqakunaqa allinmi kanku qayanapaq huk kitikunata, wakinkunaqa allin qayanapaq ima taqapaqpas suyukunapi.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Kay quykunamanqa pitillapi qayakunmanmi mana qullqillamanta mayqin qayanakunamantapas.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Fotografiaq kamachiyninkunapas grawasqa videomanqa churanata atikullanmansi.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Foto hapiyllapas manan allinchu, anchapas manataqmi hamutankimanpaschu video rurayta kaymanta.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Drone nisqata palachinki inaqa, qawariyraq imatas hapinki chayta, inallataq imakunawansi atipakunman chayta qawariy.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Dron palachiyqa aeropuertop sispanpi utaq achka runa kachkaptinmi aswan manam allin yuyaychu.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Kunanaqa avionpi illanapaqa manañas kikin aerolineamanta rantinkichu, ñawpaqtaqa qawanki maypim pisi qullqillapaq tarinki.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Huk kutinkunapi, chay kikin pawaymi kanman imaymana chaninkunayuq achka agregados nisqakunapi chaymantapas allin chanin rantiymi maskanan rurunta chaymantapas sitio web aerolíeap nisqata tapuna waqaychanaykiq ñawpaqninmantaraq.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Chiqaqpichu manam chanin visa nisqa chikan pacha kanapaq huk suyukunapi hawa suyumanta puriq hina utaq qhatuyrayku, yachakuq hina riy pasaqlla unay pacha kanata nin chikan pachalla rinamantaqa.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Lliwlla, hawa suyupi tiyayqa unay pacha, hinaqa mañakunqachá huk visa nisqata ñawpaqtaraq.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Yachapakuqpa visansi imaymana mañakuykunayuqraq ruwayniyuqkunawanraq turistakuna utaq rantikuypi puriqkunamantaqa.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: lliw suyukunapaqqa may yachaywasipichá yachaqi kayta munan chaypin carta de oferta nisqa kanan, inallataq yachaqikunaqa rikuchinankun maymantan qullqita urqunqa chayta uk wata yachaqi kayllanpaqpas.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Llankana wasiwan tapurikuy, hinallataq puririchiq suyu wasiwanpas may suyupin yachakuq kayta munanki chaymanta hina, ima kamachikuypas riqsinaykipaq.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Diplomático kanman chayqa, hawa suyukunapi llankaypa llapanhina nimunmi inpuesto renta nisqapita qawachinan chay llaqtapi tarikusaspa.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Impuesto sobre la renta nisqakus mana kaqlla ruwasqachu sapa suyupi, chaynallataq tasas impositivas, tramo nisqanku imakunapas sapaqkamas sapa suyupi.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Wakin suyukunapiqa EE.UU hinallataq canadápi impusto nisqaqa huñukun sapan llaqtapi waqtataq suyuntinpi, chayraykun tasa nisqa sapanyan sapa suyupi.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Qillqachakusqa inmigracionmi manam kanchu utaq formalidadhina haykaq llaqtaykipiman hamusqayki chayaruspaqa, aduanas controlmi piñachikunapaq kanman.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Allinta yuyaychakunayki atisqaykita chaymantapa nama apamuwaqchu chaymantapas ninaykin imaymanakunata allin kay patanpi kaqkunata.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Atiylla qhatukunapi qallariyqa, ima kamapas kallpachaymi web nisqa chawpinta chusaykunapaq.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Allin tiyarukuspaña Formateo chaymanta webpa qillqayninpi, paypa web kitinta qispichinman.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Tukllaki kaspa puriwaq chayqa allin chaninmi riqsichikunaykipaqqa, ichaqa manas quyta quwallaqchu.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Uk suyukunapi tiyaspa musuq kawsaykuna yachayqa, chaninmi, runakunata iman riqsikunman, chaypin kamakunman ima atiykunapas, musuq yachaykuna atipay ima.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Hinallataqmi allin kanman qullqi imapaqpas aypachiy aswan unay chaypi kanaykipaq, ñataq huk llamkaykuna mana chaninllapaq qurpachanata qunku inallataq mikunatapas, wakinkunallataq payllanku ima chaninchayninta.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikingo nisqakunaqa paraq yakunpin yana quchaman inalltaq caspio quchaman chayarqanku. Kunanpas kanraqmi chay ina purinapaq. Qawariy chay ina purinapaq apusimi kamachita.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Mar Blanco-Báltico nisqaq quchaq sankhanmi aypachin Océano Ártico nisqata Mar Báltico nisqawan, Onega quchanta, Lodoga quchanta, San Peterburgo nisqapiwan, mayukuna quchakunapiwan chaykunamantaraq.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Onega qucha Volgawan tinkuchisqan kachkan, hinaqa chayawaqmi Caspio mama quchamanta Rusia suyunta puririspa.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Ama iskayaychu, maypachachus chayanki wanpuq sayanan kitiman chayqa. Reqsinkin uk puripakuq chusaqkunata paykunan willasunki yachayninta.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Sanpapi inallan yanapay willakuykunata churanki, muelle nisqanta puririspa, runakunaman sispaykuspa wanpunta pichaspa, machana wasipi wanpu apaqkunawan rimanakuyta munaspa, ukkunapiwan.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Aswan achka atisqayki runawan parlanakuy. Pacha puririyninman hina, lliwcha riqsisunkiku hinaqa qawarichisunkiku ima wanpupis sapanka kasqankuta.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Allin qawanawanmi aynikuypi sapa kutilla chusaq aerolinataqa akllana kchkanki.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Hamutaptikiñapas, ukuykimanta hamuq hina ancha illasqaykiwan aerolínea nisqanku akllaynikimantas, yupaychanaykis mana kaqllachu ima allinkuna qukusqankumanta chaynallataq may ancha rinaman as allin kanman huk aerolínea hina ayllullamanta kaqpi.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways y Turkish Airlines aerolínea nisqakunahina anchatapuni mastarinku yanapayninkuna África suyuman chaymantapas Áfricaq hatun llaqtakunanman chinpachiyta qunku allin aypaq qullqillapaq aerolíneas Europeas chaykunahina.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines phawan 39 kitiman 30 Africa suyupi 2014 watamanta.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Pachayki kan chusanaykipaq inaqa, qawariy imaynatas hayka kasqanta llapanpi Africa suyupi, uk tiqsimuyuntinman muyuypi.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ama qunqankichu visas nisqaq yapakuq chaninkunata, lluqsinapaq impuestunkunata, transporte terrestre nisqata, imaymanakunapiwan, llapan wak África suyuq hawan llaqtakunata.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Munaspa muyuyta lliw tiqsimuyupa uray lawninpiqa, kamallas mayqin pawaywan illanaykipaq chaynallataq mayman, mana ancha achka transoceánica rinapaq kasqan rayku.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Manam ni mayqin alianza aereaqa wasapachinchu kimsantin cruces mama quchakunata Uran ImisfIriwpi (SkyTeamtaq manan wasapachinchu ni mayqin cruceskunatapas).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Chaspa, Star Alliance llapantan qatan, manataqmi Sur Pacífico antintaqa Santiago de Chilemanta Tahitíkama, LATAM Oneworld phawayninmi.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Kamachikuqkunapa suyumanta rimayninkunam hinallaraq hukmanyachin Armenia, Azerbaiyán llaqtakunapa tupanakuyninta.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Distrito del Canal nisqankus (holandéspi: Grachtengordel) allin riqsisqa llaqta 17 pachak watapi, Binnenstad de Ámsterdamta muyuriq.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Lliw sayan riqsisqa kasqan Pachantinpi Patrimonio nisqa hina UNESCO ñawpa chanin kasqanwan manam rikchakuyniyuq, hina chaninchayninqa aswan allinpi qawarisqa kasqan suyuntinpi.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, Pichqa Allpa pata nispa ninanta nin, Riomaggiore mayu patan huchuy pichqa llaqtakunata nin, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza, Monterosso nisqapiwan, Italia suyuq Liguria chaypi tarikuqnin.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: UNESCO qillqaynin rapipi kachkanku tiqsimuyuntinpi qillqasqa.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Karu pachak watakunapis, runakunas ruwasqa sumaqllawan kancha patakunata sayaq pachamamapatapi chaymantapas allin qhata sayaqkunapipas hatun qochakama.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Ima munay kasqan aswan allin llamkana wasin tikariymi. Ñankuna, trenkuna wanpukuna llaqtakunata tinkuchin, carrokunataq mana chayanchu hawamanta.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Bélgica Suiza suyupiwan Frances simipa rimakuyninqa yaqapas wak hina Franciapi Frances simimanta hamun, ichaqa yaqapas kikillanhina.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Huk allin cristiano puririymi qapaq kayqa ñakariq wakcha kay allichanapaqmi, hinaqa qullqi huñusqa manqos wasip chaypipunin kachkan, chaypaq nisqapunin, chayrayku.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Ichaqa, lliw belgakuna chaynallataq suizokuna francés rimaqkunas kay riqsisqa francésta yachapakusqaku yachay wasipi, chay raykus mana sasachakunkuchu riqsisqa francés yupanapi rimariptikipas.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Inantin suyukunapi munay napaykuyqa riqsikun “Hola (imaynallan) nisqallawanmi.”
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Ichaqa, Malasiapiqa, purunpi tiyaq malayokuna, ninmi “hamuy”, tuqsina rukaman rikchakuq kuskuman qawasqa hina, occidental suyukunapi qawarichikun, hinaqa chayllapaqmi qawarichina.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Chayman rikchakupta, britanicomanta illaq runa España suyupi pantanmanmi napaykuyta kacharpariytapas makinta huqarispa pi kuyuriqmanpas (napaykunay chayachina runaman) kutimunanpaq hina ruranman makinwan.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Yanapaq rimaykuna hatarichisqa rimaykunan kanku imapas mana sasallawan rimasqa kananpaq llaqtakunapi, huk niraq kaptinqa sasatachá rimanakunkuman.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Lingua franca nisqamantan taqasqa kachkan, pachak rimayninkuna hinaqa atipayniyuqman tukupunku huk imaraykupas, rimanakuypi huk simikuna rimaqkunawan.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Rupay punchaw, illaqkuna yanqakunata qawarinkuman muspaspa hina yakuta hina qawarinku (hukkunatapas).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Kaykunaqa mana allinmi kankuman illaqkuna qatirinkuman hinaqa, kallpata usuchispa hinallataq yaku puchuqtapas.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Ichaqa ancha rupakuq chin pampakuna supay chirimanpas tutakunapi tikrakullanmanmi. Chiri qatatay unquypa manchakunapaqmi kanman sichus manam allin quñi pachayuq kawaq chayqa.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Chiraw pachapi, wanwakunawan qawayta munanki sichus sacha sachapi puririyta munaki hina.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Apachkanki quñi yunka ukunta chaypa, tunpachallanta vehículoykip punkunta kichasqata saqirunki chayqa, chayllamanmi llapan chuspichakuna haykuyakapunku qanwan kuchkan.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Aviar unquymi utaq pichinkukunata iskaynin ñuñuq uywakunatapiwan pichinkukunawan unqurachinkuman.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Pisi waranqa ruwaykuna hina runakunapi willakamunkun, ichaqa wakin aswan mana allinmi karqanku.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Yaqapas llapanku winanku kanchapi pisqukunawan llamkaq runakunata, ichaqa huk manchachiy pisqukuna qawaqkunapaq kanpasmi.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Noruegaqmi fiordo escarpado nisqakunaqa hinallataq qichwakuna, hinallaman, hanan hatun pata panpaman qawarichin, yaqapas kaqllaman kasqanta.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: “Vidde” nispan sutichakun hatun panpa kaptin mana mallkiyuq, sumaq panpallaña.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Rogaland, Agder nisqapiqa “hei” nisqa sutiwanmi sutichanku, chaki panpa mana sachakunayuq kasqanta ichaqa huchuy sachachakunallawan.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Urqukunapi chullunkuqa manan allin takyasqachu, ichaqa urayman suchunku. Kayqa raqrachinqan, wayqukunata ima hatarichinqa, ichaqa ritiwan pakasqan kankuman.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Chullunku tuqukunaq perqankuna wasi qatakuna ima urmayamuytas atinman chaymantapas patasqan wayqukunapas wichqarapuyta atinman.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Ichaqa, ukmanmi kachalakuyninqa inallataq munay kaynin ritiy mitapi, aska urqukunayuq chaypin ritikunata chaskin chaymantataq esquí inallataq snowboard nisqapi pukllakun.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.
